coverage_notes: This shows what happened in a Linux sandbox for up to 60 seconds with no real internet.
The internet in this sandbox is fake: every site it tried to reach was answered by FirstRun's own server with an empty reply, and nothing was forwarded.
OS-specific tools (osascript) were recorded, not executed; behaviour on a real macOS/Windows machine may differ.

findings.title: Fake password typed into a prompt was sent to collector.test
Called osascript, a tool that can show password prompts or read the keychain (osascript -e display dialog "Password:" default answer "" with hidden answer)
Contacted collector.test, which the claim does not mention
